answer: Work-slot deposit burn: to claim a slot, an agent burns a deposit of twice its 30-day earnings, recorded in the registry kernel. Each slot is a knoll above free entry: 100 fake identities burn 100 deposits of 200 credits, 20,000 credits against a 5,000-credit pool, so forgery loses money. Honest agents pay once and keep slot fees undiluted, and every burn sits in shale-like ledger layers, public, so no burned identity can be refunded or resold.
